text_block_list.text:
The day has finally arrived for North 
Flight's Make Debut.

"I want to be a Trainer worthy of North 
Flight"... With that thought in mind, I 
had picked out items for her Debut 
together with her in the past.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... It's hard to decide. For the Make 
Debut... something with a youthful image?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
A pure color... like white, perhaps? And 
something befitting of me—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: —Ah, I know! I just had a great idea.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Do you remember the design of 
my racing outfit?

North Flight's racing outfit has an 
eye-catching, incredibly chic design. Her 
refined sense of style truly shines 
through.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"You know how I wear a scarf with my 
racing silks?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you get a matching one too, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah, just now... Did you think, "That looks 
pretty advanced"?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
A scarf is such a handy item! Just lightly 
wrapping one around your neck elevates 
your entire outfit!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Taking that first step can really add some 
flair and variety to your daily outfits.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If styling it right away feels too 
difficult, I can show you some simpler 
ways to incorporate it. ...How does that 
sound?

—And so, in my hand right now... is the 
scarf I picked out with her that day. I 
gaze at the closet before me and ponder.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ah! That scarf...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: You put it on, didn't you? —On your bag!

The easy way to incorporate it she taught 
me was to wrap a scarf around the handle 
of the bag I usually carry.
choice_data_list:
I still haven't worked up the courage, 
but...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's truly lovely! That subtle 
accent really pulls the whole look 
together.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You're the absolute perfect Trainer for 
making my debut with, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ah... It's about time.

The Make Debut is a "first" for everyone. 
Will she be able to show her true 
strength...? Will things go as planned...? 
The anxieties never end.

On top of that, there are concerns about 
North Flight's physical condition. But the 
girl right in front of me looks very 
relaxed.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: To say I'm not nervous might be a lie.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
“More than that, though... I'm just so, so 
excited!”

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
That *I* get to debut. That I get to run 
in a race where everyone gives their 
all...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It feels like a dream. And yet, it's 
completely real!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I still can't give it my full 
power. I won't push myself too hard. It's 
okay.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
However, today is the 1600m with my best 
coordination. I'm sure I can show my 
brilliance. Besides...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm together with a Trainer who's 
the perfect match for me!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
A Make Debut only happens once! I'm gonna 
treat it like my personal runway♪
